text: 前三季度，科创板上市公司净利润增长474.6%，创业板上市公司净利润增长22.7%，以人工智能、机器人、创新药为代表的新质生产力上市公司业绩高速增长。人工智能板块净利润同比增长281.0%，增速较半年报加快14.5个百分点，机器人、智能穿戴设备领域上市公司净利润同比增长94.8%、63.2%。 (央视新闻)
text_en: In the first three quarters, net profit of listed companies on the STAR Market grew 474.6%, and net profit of ChiNext listed companies grew 22.7%. Listed companies representing new quality productive forces, such as those in AI, robotics and innovative drugs, saw rapid earnings growth. Net profit in the AI sector rose 281.0% YoY, 14.5 percentage points faster than in the half-year report, while net profit of listed companies in robotics and smart wearable devices rose 94.8% and 63.2% YoY. (CCTV News)
